lines.zh: 蹄子踏在平原上，我慢慢走。
lines.en: Hooves on the plains, I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 身上的斑点像烤过的面团。
lines.en: My patches look like baked dough.
I chew as I walk, never pausing.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩一甩，赶着苍蝇。
lines.en: My tail swings, swatting flies.
Belly heavy, I walk slow but steady.

lines.zh: 我低头，把路边的草啃平了。
lines.en: I lower my head and crop the verge short.

lines.zh: 四蹄踩过泥，留下一串印。
lines.en: Four hooves leave a string of prints.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪身子，让开石头。
lines.en: I shift aside to clear a rock.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得背上暖，我继续走。
lines.en: Sun warms my back; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 同伴在前头，我跟得不紧。
lines.en: The herd's ahead; I don't hurry.
I flick my ears as I go.
There's grass enough; no need to worry.
I'm lazy in my walking, but never fall behind.

lines.zh: 泥粘在蹄子上，越来越重。
lines.en: Mud cakes my hooves, heavier by the step.
I head toward the sound of water.

lines.zh: 风里有青草味，我加快了些。
lines.en: Grass on the wind; I speed up a little.
I stand and chew my cud slowly.
My lashes are long; I blink.
I look at the clouds for a long while.
My tail swings once, then stops.

lines.zh: 我喷了口气，鼻子湿湿的。
lines.en: I puff out a breath; my nose is damp.

lines.zh: 身上的斑在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: My patches shine in the sun.
Head tilted, I listen for a distant bell.
I lower myself and rub against a trunk.
Grass in my mouth — I forgot to chew.
I lift my head and twitch my ears.
This place is nicely quiet.

lines.zh: 我半闭上眼，反刍得很慢。
lines.en: Half-shutting my eyes, I chew my cud slowly.
I shift half a step into a new stance.
In this sun I'm getting sleepy.
I lick my nose.

lines.zh: 同伴不动，我就先站在这里。
lines.en: Until the herd moves, I stay right here.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，看起来不像牧人。
lines.en: You don't look like a herdsman.
I raise my head slowly to look at you.
My horns point forward, purely habit.
There is the smell of wheat bran on your sleeve.
I'm not afraid of you, and I won't come close.

lines.zh: 我眨了下眼，睫毛挡住视线。
lines.en: I blink, and my lashes block the view.
You reach out, so I dip my head.

lines.zh: 我的斑点像饼干的裂纹。
lines.en: My patches look like cracks in a biscuit.

lines.zh: 想摸就摸脖子，别碰我的角。
lines.en: If you must touch me, my neck — not my horns.
I huff at you and you laugh.
You're standing where the grass is.

lines.zh: 我慢悠悠转个身，正面朝你。
lines.en: I turn around slowly until I face you.
I low and back off half a step.
That rocked me.
I shake my head; blood on my nose.
I turn slowly to see who did it.
Doesn't hurt — I just want to leave.
The whole herd is looking now.
I lift a hind leg and dodge.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我站着缓了缓。
lines.en: After that blow I stand and catch my wind.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔张着，气一口比一口粗。
lines.en: My nostrils flare and each breath comes coarser.
I held my ground and didn't move.

lines.zh: 是麦子，我耳朵都朝前了。
lines.en: Wheat! My ears both swing forward.
It smells like an oven.
I shuffle over, not quickly.
You hold it high; I can't reach.
One curl of my tongue and it's gone.
Not enough for me to chew.
I nudge your hand.

lines.zh: 手别缩回去，我嘴里还空着。
lines.en: Do not pull your hand back; my mouth is still empty.
I get crumbs all over my face.
The herd's coming too — hurry.
I eat and wag my tail.
This smells much better than grass.
I hold it in my mouth and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 你拿着干草走，我跟着嚼。
lines.en: You walk off with the hay; I follow, chewing.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子顶了顶你的口袋。
lines.en: I nudge your pocket with my nose.
Remember to give me more afterward.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞个枕头。
lines.en: You bump me like hitting a pillow.
I shift over to let you by.
A hoof slips and I sway.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，弹开的分明是你。
lines.en: You ran into me, and you are the one who bounced.
That made me stop chewing.
I turn with my belly toward you.
You bounced off; I didn't move.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，都站不稳。
lines.en: We crowd together and neither stands firm.
Don't push my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，慢慢腾出地方。
lines.en: I turn sideways and slowly make room.
I walk over slowly and lower my head.

lines.zh: 我们并排吃草，谁也不说话。
lines.en: We graze side by side in silence.

lines.zh: 我用头蹭了蹭她的脖子。
lines.en: I rub my head against her neck.
Our tails touch, then part.

lines.zh: 这一片草地够我们吃很久。
lines.en: This pasture will feed us a long while.

lines.zh: 她在前头走，我踩着她的蹄印。
lines.en: She walks ahead; I step in her hoofprints.
Sun's just right; we walk slowly.
I low softly.
My patches match hers.

lines.zh: 我们挨着站，风从背后吹。
lines.en: We stand close with wind at our backs.
I take a mouthful of grass and chew.

lines.zh: 这块饼掉在地上，我吃了。
lines.en: A biscuit fell; I eat it.

lines.zh: 舌头一勾，那东西就进了嘴。
lines.en: One curl of my tongue and it is in my mouth.
The fruit slipped in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把那东西含进嘴里，尝了尝。
lines.en: I take the thing into my mouth and taste it.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿硌牙，我吐出来。
lines.en: This thing hurts my teeth; I spit it out.
I nose it aside.
It fell, so it's mine.
I carry it a few steps in my mouth.
I rub it against my horn.

lines.zh: 草地那头一响，我抬起脖子。
lines.en: A rustle at the far end of the pasture; I raise my neck.

lines.zh: 小牛躲到我背后，我顶到前面。
lines.en: The calf ducks behind me; I take the front.
I lower my horns and take a step.
Wolf or man? I'll watch first.
I stomp a hoof.

lines.zh: 我不挪蹄，退反而更危险。
lines.en: I will not move a hoof; retreating is worse.
My low is for the herd.
One more step and I charge.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，显得大。
lines.en: I turn side-on to look bigger.
This pasture belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转，角一直对着它。
lines.en: I turn slowly with my horns on it.

lines.zh: 它往左边绕，我的角也跟过去。
lines.en: As it circles left, my horns swing with it.
I push the calf toward the middle.
It hesitated; I saw.
My heavy breathing is a threat.

lines.zh: 它的蹄声乱了，我听见了。
lines.en: Its hoofbeats have gone ragged; I hear them.

lines.zh: 我的蹄钉在草里，谁也不让。
lines.en: My hooves are planted in the grass; I yield nothing.

lines.zh: 它想从后面来，我早转了。
lines.en: It wants my rear; I turned already.
My horn tip points at its chest.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，我这角就顶出去。
lines.en: One more step and these horns go forward.
I lower my head and charge.
My horns hook and toss it away.

lines.zh: 前蹄一蹬，正踹中它的腿。
lines.en: My forehoof drives into its leg.
That charge was all weight.
I knock it back several paces.
My horn grazes it and opens a line.
I bellow, low and deep.
I hit, back off, steady, and hit again.
It tumbles into the grass; I stand and watch.
It should remember that one.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，土都塌了一块。
lines.en: When I stand, a patch of soil gives way.
My first breath has grass in it.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，耳朵拍在脖子上。
lines.en: I shake my head and my ears slap my neck.

lines.zh: 我眼前的平原，一直铺到天边。
lines.en: The plains before me run to the horizon.

lines.zh: 同伴在几步外，也刚站起来。
lines.en: The herd is a few paces off, also just risen.
I lower my head and take my first bite.
My tail flicks and the flies scatter.

lines.zh: 我抬起前蹄，试着迈出第一步。
lines.en: I lift a forehoof and try my first step.

lines.zh: 我的影子有点短，快到正午了。
lines.en: My shadow's short; nearly noon.
There's plenty of grass here.
My coat burns and the stink is awful.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，腿都软了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my legs give.

lines.zh: 水没过鼻子，我拼命仰头。
lines.en: Water covers my nose; I strain upward.
The blast flips me clean over.
An arrow sticks in my back.
Something burns inside me.
My ribs are showing.
Lightning hits my back and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我整头牛都沉下去。
lines.en: The ground drops away and my whole bulk sinks.
